title: 左上挑斩
author: Kingdom Come Combat
first_page: 输入：左、右、左。左击、右击后，再以左击收尾，绕过对手武器。
second_page: 关键在于不要让第二击成为终点。右击牵开敌人的剑，最后一记左击才顺着空隙上挑。翻到这里，你已经开始练习左上挑斩。

en_us.title: Lower left strike
en_us.first_page: Input: Left, Right, Left. Follow the opening cuts with a final rising strike from the left around the opponent's weapon.
en_us.second_page: Use the right strike to draw the enemy's sword aside, then lift the final left cut through the opening.
